description: Migrate the checkout/payment form from Stripe Elements to Adyen Drop-in for a web application. The migration must follow: SDK swap (replace Stripe Elements with Adyen Web Drop-in component), tokenization migration (Stripe token → Adyen token, update backend to accept Adyen token format), 3DS/SCA configuration (configure Strong Customer Authentication flow — Adyen's 3DS2 implementation, challenge handling, RSA key exchange), sandbox testing (test all card networks, 3DS challenge flows, decline scenarios in Adyen sandbox), canary release (deploy to 5% of users via feature flag, monitor error rates), and full rollout (100% of users). A rollback plan must exist (feature flag revert to Stripe Elements). Risk factors: 3DS challenge UX differences, token format incompatibility breaking the backend, and PCI scope changes (Drop-in vs Elements SAQ-A scope). Tools available: Adyen Web SDK, Stripe Elements, feature flags, Jest (for component tests), Adyen sandbox, browser DevTools.
